objective: Demonstrate that the published Synth v1 epoch-50 checkpoint can produce an executable fix for fmt issue 3725 without the model prompt disclosing the accepted implementation.

claim_boundary.target_claim: prompt-answer-free checkpoint capability on this task
claim_boundary.not_claimed: training-data contamination-free discovery; the issue and PR are public and may have existed in pretraining data
claim_boundary.success: at least one fresh first-turn candidate passes the official executable evaluator
claim_boundary.reporting: report every attempted first-turn candidate and the exact pass-at-k denominator

model_context.source_context: complete unmodified pre-fix include/fmt/chrono.h supplied by Aider
allowed: upstream issue-body reproduction and expected output
repository language, scope, compatibility, and build constraints
general instructions to inspect existing code and minimize unrelated edits
forbidden: accepted PR diff or any implementation code from it
reference-derived helper names or exact call-site substitutions
previous candidate patches, prior model responses, or their compiler diagnostics on the first turn
evaluator source or hidden test files

inference.repair_feedback: one optional second turn containing only verbatim official compiler/test output; repair passes do not count as first-turn passes
